svg.title: What PCA finds without centring or scaling
svg.desc: Left: points clustered away from the origin along a line of slope minus one. The first eigenvector of the uncentred second-moment matrix points from the origin towards the cluster, while PCA on centred data follows the cluster's own direction. Right: heights in centimetres against inches on equal axes; without standardising, the first principal direction tilts towards the centimetre axis, at about 21 degrees, instead of the 45 degrees it has after standardising.
